# judo-tatami-core

> Foundational library for the JUDO platform providing EMF-based transformation trace tracking and a composable workflow engine for orchestrating model-to-model transformations.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+ (single-module project, OSGi bundle packaging)
- EMF-based tracing framework recording source-to-target EObject mappings across multi-step transformation pipelines
- Lightweight workflow engine with sequential, parallel, conditional, and repeat flow types that nest arbitrarily
- OSGi Declarative Services for dynamic model service binding and trace management
- Core dependencies: Eclipse EMF 4.22, OSGi 6.0.0, Google Guava, SLF4J, Lombok
- Part of the [judo-community](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-community) aggregator ecosystem
- License: EPL-2.0 OR GPL-2.0 WITH Classpath-exception-2.0

## Depends on

- [emf-genmodel-generator](../../eclipse/emf-genmodel-generator): Generates Builder pattern classes and helpers from EMF GenModel files

## Used by

- [judo-platform](../judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
- [judo-runtime-core](../judo-runtime-core): Multi-module runtime engine — data access, business logic, REST, and security
- [judo-runtime-core-esm-itest](../judo-runtime-core-esm-itest): Integration tests for ESM-to-RDBMS transformation pipeline
- [judo-services](../judo-services): OSGi runtime services enabling multiple data models in a single Karaf container
- [judo-tatami](../judo-tatami): Model transformation pipeline — ESM/PSM to deployable application artifacts
- [judo-tatami-base](../judo-tatami-base): PSM transformation pipeline — models to schemas, expressions, and configurations
- [judo-tatami-client](../judo-tatami-client): ESM-to-UI model transformation using Eclipse Epsilon ETL
- [judo-tatami-jsl](../judo-tatami-jsl): JSL-to-runtime model transformation engine (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, etc.)
- [judo-tatami-util](../judo-tatami-util): Utility facade for EMF model transformation traces
